tailoring.headline: E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java & REST APIs | 5+ Years Experience
tailoring.summary: Backend and e-commerce developer with 5+ years of professional experience building enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong foundation in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and database optimization. Experienced in headless e-commerce, third-party integrations, CI/CD deployments, and techno-functional collaboration with international stakeholders and business teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Software Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining your e-commerce engineering team. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in backend architecture, headless commerce integrations, and high-performance API development.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Architected, extended, and maintained large-scale B2B and B2C enterprise platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211), delivering robust product catalog, pricing, and order management solutions.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, developing custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Performance Optimization & Backend
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring using FlexibleSearch and SQL, significantly reducing response latency and improving transaction speed across high-load e-commerce environments.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Deployments
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), managing Hotfolders, Cronjobs, and integrations within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical background aligns with your engineering goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend engineering expertise to your team. Having built and scaled complex platforms for global leaders like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited about contributing my strong Java, Spring, and API integration skills to build high-performance digital experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce development expertise, strong Java/Spring backend skills, and a proven track record in high-performance API integration to your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Deepthi, I saw your post regarding software engineering opportunities. With 5+ years building enterprise e-commerce platforms and APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your team. Best regards, Kranti
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Software Engineer position. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and scalable platform architectures.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached to this email. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026.

I look forward to discussing how my experience can benefit your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
